# Urbancode Edutech - IT Training Institute in Chennai

Urbancode Edutech is a premier IT and coding training institute based in Chennai (Velachery & Pallikaranai). We specialize in job-oriented courses with 100% placement assistance.

## Core Courses
- **MERN Stack Development**: MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js.
- **Full Stack Development**: Python, Java, .NET.
- **Python with AI**: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI.
- **Data Analytics & Science**: Power BI, SQL, Python for Data.
- **AWS DevOps & Cloud**: Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
- **Software Testing**: Manual and Automation (Selenium).
- **UI/UX Design**: Modern product design workflows.

- **Pallikaranai Branch**: Kamakoti Nagar, Pallikaranai, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600100.
